benchmark.name: MMDocIR page-level evaluation
benchmark.official_candidate_scope: pages belonging to the query source document

transition.reusable_boundary: post-vision visual states under the frozen 768-token processor contract

baselines.raw_rebuild: decode every source page, run vision and language paths, then build the identical serving generation
baselines.stale_index: serve the previous adapter generation without recompilation; excluded by the changed terminal semantics and measured separately
baselines.query_bridge: map new queries into the old index; the completed bridge experiment loses 0.01587 nDCG@10 versus the replayed v0.2 index
baselines.terminal_rewrite: valid only for physical layout-policy changes and inapplicable when adapter/projection semantics change

claim_boundary: This is one complete adapter/projection transition for ColQwen2.5 on MMDocIR. The official metric is source-document page retrieval; the 20-query global candidate test is an internal serving-fidelity probe. SQ8 and atomic rename are systems components, not standalone novelty.
